summary: Restore the final object suffix -ne in k-maḥké-wo-lan-ne
rationale: The corpus at 11/307 reads kmaḥkewolanne, including final -ne ('them'), matching 'erzählte sie uns'. The same quotation in glossary entry ḥky, stem III, Infectum-wa, also has k-maḥké-wo-lan-ne. The trǧm quotation drops this syllable; it is not merely a clitic-boundary difference.
